profile.reading: Per QTS own site, this San Antonio 2 (San Antonio II) facility is located at 8535 Potranco Road, San Antonio, TX 78251 on a 32 acre campus with 90 MW+ power capacity. No individual building/data hall names or square footage are published.
profile.capacity_note: 90 MW+ power capacity on a 32 acre campus (self reported)

profile.facility_type_note: QTS facilities in Texas (Irving, San Antonio, Tarrant County), Arizona (Maricopa County), Ohio/New Albany, New Jersey (Piscataway), Illinois (Chicago), and Colorado (Arapahoe County), all confirmed by Wikipedia as regions where QTS operates, though this session's exhausted WebSearch budget prevented per-metro depth beyond the company-level Wikipedia summary.
